summary: Marvell Technology filed an 8-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders held on June 25, 2026. Stockholders voted on director elections, advisory say-on-pay, ratification of auditor Deloitte, and a shareholder proposal for an independent board chairman. Additionally, the company announced a quarterly dividend of $0.06 per share declared by the Board, payable July 30, 2026. This is a routine annual meeting disclosure with a standard dividend declaration, containing no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or management changes. The filing is a routine current report with no event-driven catalyst.
